tasks.title: Create docs/pilots/pilot-interpersonal-line.md pilot runbook
acceptance_criteria: AC-01: File exists at docs/pilots/pilot-interpersonal-line.md
AC-02: Frontmatter includes id, title, description, sidebar_label
AC-03: Pilot Objectives section defines validation targets: module sequence, L1→L3 progression, perspective-taking and repair practice safety, trust-building across difference

AC-04: Participant Criteria section includes Kegan stage diversity targets (30% Institutional, 40% boundary, 30% Interindividual), deliberate social identity diversity recruitment, clinical screening language, and participant range (15-20)
AC-05: Consent & Screening section includes Tier 2 risk disclosure and references EI-20 Safety Addendum screening criteria for conflict material (EI-10) and cross-difference dialogue (EI-11)
AC-06: Facilitation Requirements section specifies cross-cultural dialogue experience, clinical backup for EI-10 and EI-11, and Tier 2 protocol activation

AC-07: Data Collection section defines pre/post perspective-taking accuracy measure (IRI or equivalent), trust rating, weekly practice log, module completion tracking, safety incident log, and weeks 4 and 8 qualitative debriefs
AC-08: Revision Triggers section defines safety incident trigger and >30% drop-off trigger with immediate review/pause procedure
AC-09: Module Sequence & Timeline section presents 8-week schedule mapping all 4 core modules plus integration capstone to weeks with time estimates
AC-10: All module cross-references use correct relative paths and existing file IDs
AC-11: Safety Addendum reference points to internal/safety/emotional-interpersonal-safety-addendum.md
